title: Photonz opens at login, on by default, with a switch in Settings to turn it off
goal: Photonz lives in the menu bar, and capture shortcuts and the agent connection only work while it is running. It should start on its own when you log in, quietly in the menu bar with no window popping up, and Settings should have one switch to turn that off. The switch is on by default.
notes: User, 2026-10-26 intake: 'I also want as a high pri thing for an option to start photonz on startup (default to on)'. Checked from intake: nothing in Sources registers a login item today (no SMAppService, LaunchAtLogin or LoginItem anywhere). Photonz is a menu-bar app: AppCoordinator.swift:117 sets the activation policy to accessory and PhotonzApp.swift:80 has the MenuBarExtra, so starting quietly is the natural fit. Settings is Sources/Photonz/SettingsDialog.swift, a single Form page whose header comment says it only lists silenced questions; this adds a General section, so update that comment. TRAP: the task 'Settings installs the Photonz skills for Claude Code and Copilot' (the-agent-server-and-skill-come-inside-photonz-a) is editing SettingsDialog.swift right now (Agents section); land after it or rebase onto it, never undo its section. TRAP: the probe and every walk launch the app constantly; registering the probe as a login item would make the test app start on every login, so the probe must never register. SMAppService.mainApp needs the app at a stable path; a bundle run from dist/ registers that path, which is fine for Dev but say in the audit what happens when dist/ is rebuilt. Applies to Current too unless shared code makes that automatic (the porting rule).
acceptance: Settings has an 'Open at login' switch (plain short label, no em dashes) in a General section at the top of the page, placed by the placement contract. It is on for a new install, and the app registers itself as a login item on first launch without asking.

Uses the system login item API (SMAppService.mainApp), so it appears under System Settings > General > Login Items as Photonz, and turning it off there shows as off in Photonz the next time Settings opens (the switch reads the real system state, it never trusts a stored copy).
Starting at login opens nothing but the menu bar icon: no Welcome window, no editor window, no Dock icon, no focus taken. A normal launch from Finder or the Dock behaves exactly as today.

Each bundle registers only itself: Photonz, Photonz Dev and Photonz Probe never register one another. The Probe app and any walk never register a login item (a walk must not leave the test app starting at every login); the Dev app follows the same default as release.
If registration fails or macOS says it needs approval, the switch says so in one line with a button that opens Login Items in System Settings. It never prompts more than once per launch.
Turning the switch off unregisters; updating the app (a new version over the old) keeps the login item working.
The default and the read-back logic live in a testable core type, unit tested; the system call sits behind a small protocol so tests never register anything.

Try path: fresh install of the release build, launch once, log out and back in: the Photonz icon is in the menu bar and no window opened. Turn the switch off, log out and in: Photonz is not running. Proved in the audit with System Settings Login Items screenshots and the switch in both states.
Audit written under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
